title: Matrix-Based Ant Colony Search with Batched Decoding for Hierarchical Replenishment Routing: A Stylized Case Study Based on Korean City Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.15338v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study a stylized single-vehicle replenishment-routing problem in which the cities of a national logistics network are both demand points and supply points: a vehicle of limited capacity delivers to every city once, and when its load is insufficient for the next city it must detour to a city already served that can still supply goods. A 100-node benchmark is built from Korean population and geographic data, with the cities divided into 10 levels; the per-visit supply coefficient and the allowed number of stops decrease geometrically with the level. Building on matrix-based ant colony optimization, we keep the states of the whole colony in arrays, couple route construction with a fixed greedy replenishment-decoding policy, and evaluate the candidate moves of a local search in batches. With frozen parameters and 30 runs on seeds never used for tuning, the matrix-based ant colony search with the batch local search (MACO) reaches a mean

translated_title: 基于矩阵的蚁群搜索与批量解码求解分层补给路径问题：基于韩国城市数据的风格化案例研究
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一个风格化的单车补给路径问题，其中国家物流网络中的城市既是需求点也是供给点：一辆容量有限的车辆为每个城市送货一次，当其载货量不足以供应下一个城市时，必须绕道至一个已经服务过且仍能提供货物的城市。基于韩国人口和地理数据构建了一个包含100个节点的基准测试集，城市被划分为10个层级；每次访问的供给系数和允许的停靠次数随层级呈几何递减。在基于矩阵的蚁群优化基础上，我们将整个蚁群的状态保存在数组中，将路径构建与固定的贪婪补给解码策略相耦合，并以批处理方式评估局部搜索的候选移动。在参数冻结、使用从未参与调参的随机种子进行30次独立运行的条件下，采用批量局部搜索的矩阵蚁群搜索算法（MACO）达到了平均……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于矩阵的蚁群搜索算法（MACO），通过将蚁群状态存储于数组、耦合贪婪补给解码策略并批量评估局部搜索候选移动，求解城市兼具需求点与供给点角色的分层单车补给路径问题，并在基于韩国城市数据构建的100节点基准上验证了其性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a matrix-based ant colony search (MACO) that keeps colony states in arrays, couples route construction with a greedy replenishment-decoding policy, and evaluates local-search moves in batches, to solve a hierarchical single-vehicle replenishment routing problem where cities act as both demand and supply points, validated on a 100-node benchmark built from Korean city data.
